description: Preview what a spec fill would do WITHOUT writing anything. Returns the affected item count, a sample of up to 10 items with before→after for each attribute, and the resolved spec values. Use this to verify the filter and values before calling apply_spec_fill with a previewReceipt.

bookId.description: Optional price book id (GUID) — recorded as context for what motivated this fill.

itemIds.description: List of item ids (GUIDs) to fill. Required (mutually exclusive with itemSkus). Max 500.

itemSkus.description: List of item SKUs to fill. Required (mutually exclusive with itemIds). Max 500.

spec.description: Attribute values to set, keyed by custom field fieldName (e.g. {"binding": "Perfect", "trim_width": 6}). Mutually exclusive with templateId (unless overriding specific values).

templateId.description: Template id (GUID) — uses the template's saved spec values.

name: preview_spec_fill
title: Preview Spec Fill
